test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The _______ (sarcastic) comments by her husband made her feel uncomfortable, and she decided to walk out of the relationship.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Gracious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sarcastic"** refers to using irony to mock or convey contempt. (व्यंग्यात्मक)

 
 
• **Example:** His sarcastic remark about my dress made me feel embarrassed.
 
 
 
• **"Gracious"** means courteous, kind, and pleasant. It is the opposite of sarcastic, as it conveys positivity and warmth. (दयालु)
 
 
• **Example:** The host was gracious and made everyone feel at home during the party.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'sarcastic'** is **'gracious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Gracious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ruinous** (विनाशकारी): Something that causes great harm or destruction.

 
 
• **Example:** The ruinous effects of the earthquake left the city in shambles.
 
 
 
• **Ambiguous** (अस्पष्ट): Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were ambiguous, leaving everyone confused.
 
 
 
• **Harmonious** (सामंजस्यपूर्ण): Free from disagreement or conflict.
 
 
• **Example:** The harmonious relationship between the two teams led to a successful project.
